  let carIdx=0;
  window.v162_bal={rd:0, htg:0, comRD:0, comHTG:0};
  try{ const s=localStorage.getItem('sendwayo_express_oficial_20261029_bal_v162'); if(s) Object.assign(window.v162_bal, JSON.parse(s)); }catch(e){}
  function saveBal(){ localStorage.setItem('sendwayo_express_oficial_20261029_bal_v162', JSON.stringify(window.v162_bal)); }
  window.v162_getFeeEnvioHT=function(m){ if(m>=20&&m<=99)return 0; if(m>=100&&m<=249)return 0; if(m>=250&&m<=499)return 0; if(m>=500&&m<=999)return 6; if(m>=1000&&m<=1999)return 18; if(m>=2000&&m<=3999)return 25; if(m>=4000&&m<=7999)return 35; if(m>=8000&&m<=11999)return 54; if(m>=12000&&m<=19999)return 63; if(m>=20000&&m<=39999)return 68; if(m>=40000&&m<=59999)return 90; if(m>=60000&&m<=74999)return 108; if(m>=75000&&m<=99999)return 115; if(m<20)return 0; return 115; };
  window.v162_getFeeRetiroHT=function(m){ if(m>=20&&m<=99)return 6; if(m>=100&&m<=249)return 12; if(m>=250&&m<=499)return 15; if(m>=500&&m<=999)return 28; if(m>=1000&&m<=1999)return 46; if(m>=2000&&m<=3999)return 81; if(m>=4000&&m<=7999)return 130; if(m>=8000&&m<=11999)return 248; if(m>=12000&&m<=19999)return 342; if(m>=20000&&m<=39999)return 576; if(m>=40000&&m<=59999)return 945; if(m>=60000&&m<=74999)return 1260; if(m>=75000&&m<=99999)return 1440; if(m<20)return 6; return 1440; };

  const NUMEROS_SUGERENCIA = [];

  window.v162_sugNum=function(input, tipo){
    const val=input.value.toLowerCase();
    const listaId='v162-sug-num-'+tipo;
    let lista=document.getElementById(listaId);
    if(!lista) return;
    let filtrados=val.length===0?NUMEROS_SUGERENCIA.slice(0,8):NUMEROS_SUGERENCIA.filter(x=> x.num.toLowerCase().includes(val) || x.nombre.toLowerCase().includes(val));
    if(filtrados.length===0){ lista.classList.add('hidden'); return; }
    lista.innerHTML='';
    filtrados.slice(0,8).forEach(item=>{
      const div=document.createElement('div');
      div.className='p-3 hover:bg-blue-50 cursor-pointer border-b text-[11px] flex justify-between items-center rounded-full';
      div.innerHTML=`<div><div class="font-bold">${item.num} - ${item.nombre}</div><div class="text-[9px] text-gray-500">Sugerencia números: ${item.num}</div></div><span class="bg-[#0f2440] text-white text-[8px] px-3 py-1 rounded-full">Usar</span>`;
      div.onclick=()=>{ input.value=item.num; lista.classList.add('hidden'); };
      lista.appendChild(div);
    });
    lista.classList.remove('hidden');
  };

  function initCarousel(){
    const imgEl=document.getElementById('v162-car-main');
    const dotsEl=document.getElementById('v162-dots');
    if(!imgEl||!dotsEl) return;
    dotsEl.innerHTML='';
    carouselImgs.forEach((_,i)=>{ const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className=i===0?'w-7 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow':'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/40'; d.id='v162-dot-'+i; dotsEl.appendChild(d); });
    setInterval(()=>{ carIdx=(carIdx+1)%carouselImgs.length; imgEl.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>{ imgEl.src=carouselImgs[carIdx]; imgEl.style.opacity='1'; },250); carouselImgs.forEach((_,i)=>{ const dot=document.getElementById('v162-dot-'+i); if(dot) dot.className=i===carIdx?'w-7 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow':'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/40'; }); },5000);
  }
  window.v162_setCar=function(i){ carIdx=i%carouselImgs.length; const imgEl=document.getElementById('v162-car-main'); if(imgEl){ imgEl.src=carouselImgs[carIdx]; } };
  window.v162_next=function(){ carIdx=(carIdx+1)%carouselImgs.length; v162_setCar(carIdx); };
  window.v162_prev=function(){ carIdx=(carIdx-1+carouselImgs.length)%carouselImgs.length; v162_setCar(carIdx); };

  window.v162_showLogin=function(){ document.getElementById('welcome-landing').classList.add('hidden'); document.getElementById('login-screen').classList.remove('hidden'); v162_fixLogin(); };
  window.v162_goWelcome=function(){ document.getElementById('welcome-landing').classList.remove('hidden'); document.getElementById('login-screen').classList.add('hidden'); };

  function v162_fixLogin(){
    const ls=document.getElementById('login-screen');
    if(!ls) return;
    ls.innerHTML=`<div class="w-full max-w-[420px] mx-auto bg-white rounded-[24px] p-6 shadow-2xl border mt-10">
      <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-3"><button onclick="v162_goWelcome()" class="text-[11px] bg-gray-100 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full">← Bienvenida</button><span class="bg-slate-900 text-white text-[10px] px-3 py-1 rounded-full">${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-DO')}</span></div>
